title: Relocate shared local Docker and Ubuntu storage to D without cleanup
objective: Move active Docker data and Ubuntu-22.04 to D:/Dev/Runtime using supported mechanisms, preserve data and old backups, and verify both products after restart.
acceptance: A1 Docker uses D; inventory preserved
A2 Ubuntu uses D; Linux paths and source commits preserved
A3 datastore baselines and endpoints match after restart
A4 backups retained; no pruning or application edits
A5 independent exact-plan/script review and sanitized evidence
dependencies: Independent reviewer approval before runtime mutation
permissions: User now authorizes relocation to D, superseding preparation-only scope of COMPLETE-001 for this separate task
Controlled stop/start of existing services and Desktop/Ubuntu required for relocation
Private backups and supported filesystem/config relocation after review
Create task issue and separate branch; no merge/release or public secrets
stop_conditions: Unrecognized mounts or insufficient backup coverage
Hash mismatch or unsupported Desktop UI
Need to delete/prune/reset/unregister/upgrade or expose secrets
